name: Shop-Bought Picks
description: Adequate steel. Bends before a good lock does.

name: Graded Tension Set
description: Nine wrenches, correctly weighted, in a roll that does not rattle.

name: Diamond-Tipped Picks
description: Cuts where lesser steel slips.

name: Electric Rake
description: Fast, loud, and forgiving of a shaking hand.

name: Vacuum Glass Cutter
description: Takes a pane out whole, and quietly.

name: Locksmith's Master Kit
description: Everything, indexed, and a decade of knowing which piece.
special_effects: Halves the penalty from an unfamiliar lock

name: Unremarkable Dark Coat
description: The most effective garment in the trade.

name: Padded Vest
description: Turns a bad night into a sore one.

name: Building Services Uniform
description: Nobody stops a person carrying a clipboard and a mop.

name: Low-Profile Climbing Rig
description: Worn under a jacket; holds a person and their nerve.

name: Tailored Suit
description: Expensive enough that nobody asks what you do.

name: Ballistic Liner
description: The one purchase that argues you should not have needed it.
special_effects: Downgrades one major injury per job to minor

name: Burner Deck
description: Cheap, disposable, and slow.

name: Signal Jammer
description: Buys silence from anything with an antenna.

name: Camera Loop Box
description: Ninety seconds of a corridor that was already empty.
special_effects: Ignores the first alarm complication of a job

name: Thermal Lance
description: Opens anything. Announces that it did.

name: Field Terminal
description: A workstation folded into a satchel, and cooled well.

name: Compact Grapple Line
description: Forty metres of very expensive rope.

name: Forged Credentials
description: Good enough for a bored guard on a long shift.

name: Soft-Soled Shoes
description: The cheapest three points of stealth in the city.

name: Low-Light Optics
description: The dark stops being an argument.

name: The Ledger
description: Names, debts, and favours. Somebody in every building owes it.
special_effects: One encounter per job may be reattempted at +0

name: Weighted Sap
description: Quiet, brief, and rarely fatal.

name: Collapsible Baton
description: Fits a coat pocket; ends most disagreements.

name: Tranquiliser Pistol
description: Nobody wakes up angry, and nobody files a shooting report.
special_effects: A failed combat check does not raise the alarm

name: Duelling Cane
description: Legal everywhere, and only a weapon in the right hands.

name: Bump Key Set
description: Crude, fast, and hard on the lock.

name: Wire Saw
description: Twenty inches of toothed cable and a lot of patience.

name: Shim Folder
description: Forty brass leaves for forty ordinary padlocks.

name: Quiet Core Drill
description: Water-cooled, slow, and much less shrill than the alternative.

name: Borescope
description: Look inside the lock before arguing with it.

name: Impressioning Kit
description: Makes the key the lock was expecting.

name: Freezing Spray
description: Makes hardened steel brittle enough to be reasonable.

name: Manipulation Dial
description: Reads the wheel pack by feel and never touches the door.
special_effects: A failed lockpicking check does not raise the alarm

name: The Whisper
description: One pick, one wrench, and a reputation older than anyone carrying it.
special_effects: A natural 1 on lockpicking is treated as a plain failure

name: Workman's Jacket
description: High-visibility, universally ignored.

name: Cut-Resistant Underlayer
description: For walls with glass on top of them.

name: Evening Dress
description: Correct for the room, which is most of the argument.

name: Insulated Suit
description: Eight minutes becomes twenty-five in the cold store.

name: Harbour Wetsuit
description: For the jobs with water in them, of which there are more than expected.

name: Security Uniform
description: The right badge, the right colour, the wrong person inside it.

name: Mesh Liner
description: Light enough to run in, heavy enough to matter.

name: The Grey Coat
description: Nobody who has worn it has ever been described accurately.

name: Concealed Pick Ring
description: One pick, worn openly, never once confiscated.

name: Chalk and String
description: The cheapest surveying kit in the trade.

name: Thin Leather Gloves
description: Grip, warmth, and no fingerprints, in that order of usefulness.

name: Corner Mirror
description: See around it before walking into it.

name: Field Medical Kit
description: Turns a bad night into a survivable one.
special_effects: One minor injury per job clears immediately

name: Climbing Claws
description: For facades that were built without ledges.

name: Felt-Soled Boots
description: Handmade, absurd-looking, and completely silent.

name: A Very Good Calling Card
description: Engraved, heavy, and belonging to somebody important who does not exist.

name: The Black Book
description: Which guard drinks, which clerk gambles, which manager is behind on rent.

name: Pocket Scanner
description: Reads a badge from a coat pocket, badly.

name: Tone Dialler
description: Speaks fluently to anything built before the war.

name: Relay Bridge
description: Convinces a circuit that a door it opened is still shut.

name: Thermal Scope
description: Shows who is in the next room before the next room does.

name: Badge Cloner
description: One handshake and the building thinks you work there.

name: Contact Microphone
description: Listens to a wheel pack through eight inches of steel.

name: Shutter Jack
description: Holds a lockdown shutter up long enough to get under it.
special_effects: Ignores the first lockdown complication of a job

name: Spoofing Console
description: Writes the building's log while the building is still living it.
special_effects: A failed hacking check leaves no log entry

name: Weighted Cosh
description: Leather, lead shot, and no paperwork.

name: Boot Knife
description: Rarely drawn, occasionally decisive.

name: Knuckle Guards
description: Turns an ordinary punch into a conclusion.

name: Prepared Rag
description: Old-fashioned, unreliable, and very quiet when it works.

name: Shock Baton
description: Immediate, non-fatal, and impossible to argue with.

name: Suppressed Pistol
description: The tool that means the job already went wrong.
special_effects: Raises notoriety whenever it is used

name: The Quiet Word
description: A cane, a reputation, and a name most doormen have heard.
special_effects: Combat failures never escalate to violence
